name: Fleetwood Electronics
old_description: We’re a full service electronics manufacturing and electronics engineering company, providing everything from PCBA to fully assembled, drop shipped product. Your design or our design.
about:
Fleetwood Electronics operates from Holland, Michigan, as a full-service electronics engineering and manufacturing company. The firm provides end-to-end services from printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) to fully assembled, drop-shipped products, working from either customer designs or its own original designs.

The company maintains 100% in-house capabilities, including PCB assembly, custom test development, final assembly, packaging, and drop shipping. It also offers original design manufacturing, handling hardware, firmware, and web dashboard development. Fleetwood supports products through FCC and UL certification processes and provides serialized component-level traceability for high-voltage or line-powered devices. No facility size, headcount, or volume figures are published.

Fleetwood serves a range of sectors including hospital safety and personnel tracking, commercial construction, food service, wireless industrial lighting control, environmental monitoring, asset tracking, eLearning, medical research data collection, telepresence, smart lighting control, power line monitoring, and direct-to-consumer products. A noted customer is Domico Med-Device, for which Fleetwood manufactured the Instant-Trace™ system, a 2022 finalist in Michigan's Coolest Thing Made contest.

Fleetwood emphasizes that its value proposition spans the full product life cycle rather than lowest cost, citing on-time and on-budget delivery of PCB assemblies, in-house custom test development, and the ability to take a product from concept to market in as little as two months.
